parsed.rationale: Both participating records have `is_test: true` — `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveMaster` in `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift` and `MockDiscogsEntityResolver.resolveRelease` in `WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift`. The two methods resolve structurally different entity types (`Master` vs `Release`), which are distinct Discogs domain concepts; their shared shape (Jaccard 0.71, empty `fields_or_signature`) reflects the narrow mock-method contract rather than meaningful duplication. Collapsing them into a generic function would couple two independent test modules across package boundaries (`Metadata` and `app:iOS`) for no production benefit.
